config.break_even_alpha: alpha_at_70pct_of_static / alpha_at_3x_split_ceiling: the multiple of the read+write migration price at which a run's captured share falls to 70% of the static arm's / to 3x the split ceiling (decisions of onestep/cascade/literal do not depend on the price, so this is exact for them).
config.denominator: heuristic static cost - oracle static cost, both per-access billed (validated equal to place_with_beliefs, tier-only)
config.static_values_from: experiments/tier_only.json (re-derived here and asserted within 0.006 points)
config.split_ceiling_from: experiments/tier_only.json reachable_ceiling (recomputed and asserted within 0.051 points of the rounded value)

policies.costaware: as onestep, but displace only if the believed saving b_new*(c[F]-c[T]) - b_victim*(c[F]-c[T]) exceeds the read+write migration cost; run with read+write pricing only.
policies.onestep: a new block takes the fastest tier with room unless a FASTER (full) tier's lowest-ranked resident ranks behind it; then it takes that slot and the resident is demoted to the fastest slower tier with room (one migration). Primary.
policies.cascade: as onestep, but the demoted resident is re-admitted below, displacing a resident it outranks there in turn; each move is one migration.
policies.literal: displacement considered only when the only tier with room is the slowest (DISK), as the task statement reads literally.

ties.new-behind: a new block does NOT displace a pre-split resident of equal belief (new loses ties)
ties.new-ahead: a new block displaces a pre-split resident of equal belief (new wins ties)
ties.between_new_blocks: the earlier-admitted block wins at equal belief in both conventions (the static pass's stable order)

assumptions: Per-access cost = slope of weighted_cost(cost_of_placement(a, n)) in n (asserted affine); fixed cost = intercept, which is 0 for every tier under PLAINTEXT and is charged once at a block's first placement, as place_with_beliefs charges it.
The token term (lambda_B x 800 tokens = 0.4 per access) is identical on every tier and cancels in every captured share; it is kept so absolute costs match place_with_beliefs.

The simulator defines NO tier-migration cost (its one-off cost is a representation change, 0 for PLAINTEXT). Migration is therefore assumed to cost one read from the source tier plus one write to the destination, with the write priced at the destination's read latency, weighted by lambda_L, no token term (read+write). A zero-migration-cost variant is reported beside it.
Initial placement (pre-split blocks at the split, a new block at admission) is free, as in place_with_beliefs.
Beliefs are fixed once assigned: pre-split blocks keep their prefix count, new blocks keep the arm's belief; nothing is promoted on later evidence.
Block sizes are uniform (asserted), so one demotion frees exactly one slot.
Displacement is decided by belief rank only; it does not weigh the migration cost against the expected saving.
Within a request, blocks are admitted in request (position) order; this is the order arrival_features assigns arrival indices in, and asserted equal to item order.

New-block beliefs replicate run_arrival_admission.main() (its helpers are imported; the inline arm construction is copied), and each arm's static value is re-derived and asserted equal to tier_only.json.
